directories.name: Anthropic claude-community
directories.submission: web form; requires a signed-in Claude account
directories.notes: Pull requests against anthropics/claude-plugins-community are closed automatically; that repository is a read-only nightly mirror of the internal review pipeline. Approved plugins install with the @claude-community suffix.

review.outcome: not approved: a reviewer asked for changes
review.blocking: A package ran without an exact version in skill text (skills/develop-with-singapore-mcp: `npx -y @olano/mcp-singapore`, `npx @olano/sg-cli`). Launchers were already pinned.
fixes: Pinned both commands to @0.4.1 in the skill and its plugin copy; bump-version.mjs now rewrites the pins and check-claude-plugins.mjs fails on any unpinned or stale @olano invocation in skill text.
Added icon (./assets/olano-singapore.svg, 512x512 viewBox) to all seven plugin.json files; validator pin moved to @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.289, which recognises the field.
review.bundled: Reviewer's finding LAUNCHER_PACKAGE_REVIEW: each plugin now carries the server it runs under server/ (scripts/build-plugin-server.mjs: about 150 readable files, largest under 256 KB; two SDK files over the limit are split unchanged into ES module parts) and .mcp.json starts it with node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/server/node_modules/@olano/mcp-singapore/dist/cli.js. check:plugins fails if the committed copy is stale; the release workflow regenerates it.
review.released: 0.4.3 (commit d6f5cb5 on main) carries the bundled server, the icon and the pinned skill text. Its plugin.json files and the vendored server all read 0.4.3.
review.directoryState: On 2026-10-04 the directory still tracked v0.4.1 (3749b11): its Updates panel said it was not picking up new commits. A GitHub push webhook to the directory was added on 2026-10-04 so later pushes to main are detected; Resubmit for review on the Review tab re-checks the latest commit.
review.next: Once the directory shows the 0.4.3 commit (or later) as detected, select Resubmit for review.

directories.name: Smithery
directories.submission: publish a public Streamable HTTP endpoint or an MCPB bundle
directories.blocker: No public HTTPS MCP endpoint and no MCPB artifact is built today. The server supports Streamable HTTP, but nothing is hosted, and PRIVACY.md states no Olano-hosted endpoint exists.
